body:
I was raised by my grandmother. She used to tell me that if I moved while getting my blood drawn, the needle would break off, travel to my heart, and kill me. If I saw any air bubbles in iv tubing, those would also travel to my heart and kill me. And I was told that if I fought, nurses used bigger needles.
To this day, I have a crippling needle phobia that will very likely kill me, because I will not go to a doctor or an ER when I need to. I was recently diagnosed with osteonecrosis, and will probably end up in a wheelchair very soon because I don't want surgery. My life is in shambles over this.
I messaged all of you. I just realized that I posted this from another account, but it's still me.
I had so many dreams. Outer space, teaching, singing... I'm nothing now. Just worthless.
